outcome: use of less reliable contraception methods
cohort: The cohort consisted of Somali women aged 18 and older with live singleton births in Olmsted County, Minnesota between 2009-2015, and an age-matched group of non-Somali women.
finding: Somali women were significantly less likely to use postpartum contraception compared to non-Somali women, and among Somali women, contraception use was less likely with older maternal age and more likely with prepregnancy contraception use.
